For SotM? Until Handelabra decides to put it on the Switch, it's strictly on the PC for me.

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
Teleporter pads of some means would be awesome. I'd prefer them to portal guns since from what I know of them from the Portal games, to get a proper use of them you'd have to lay down a portal, go ALLLLLL the way to where you want it to end up, and lay down a second one. If ou want to travel somewhere within eyesight then it's great, but long-range teleportation wouldn't really be worth it for longer distances in most cases.

But with teleporter pads you could just make your way to your local pad, pop in the coordinates to the one that best fits your needs of where you're destination is, and you're there!
